description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Interactive Brokers is hiring a Software Engineer for its Compliance Tech group. The role involves developing and delivering maintainable software, primarily in Python and Go, while working with business stakeholders to clarify requirements and solve technical problems.
Compliance technology Software Engineer building maintainable software and owning scoped projects from design through testing and delivery

Responsibilities:
• Communicate well with the business side to clarify requirements and take ownership of well-scoped projects from design through testing and delivery
• Write maintainable software that is durable and easy to extend
• Break down unfamiliar problems, investigate possible solutions independently, and ask focused questions when guidance is needed
• Learn quickly, experiment with new ideas, and evaluate whether they improve the solution

Requirements:
• Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or other Engineering with software experience
• 1–2 years of professional software development experience
• Recent graduates should have completed at least one software development internship
• Programming experience in at least one of Python, Go, C++, Rust, or Java, with the ability to build structured applications beyond basic scripting and a willingness to work primarily in Python and Go
• A solid understanding of object-oriented analysis and design, demonstrated through internships, coursework, or substantive projects
• Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the initiative to investigate unfamiliar problems and follow through on a solution
• Familiarity using Git version control
• Working familiarity with the Unix/Linux command line and basic shell scripting
• Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions and document your work
• Familiarity with unit and acceptance testing, and experience writing automated tests in your chosen programming language
• Hands-on experience using an agentic coding tool such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi.dev, or similar to develop, debug, or test software

Preferred:
• Experience with frontend development with VueJS or React
• Experience with Django or FastAPI
• Experience with Pytest
• Familiarity with SQL
• Jira and Confluence experience
• Familiarity with distributed object storage
• Experience with a container technology
